I've read through the round 15 digest and updated Gus's post. 

Assuming Gus's previous post was missed in a split-board situation, he repeats his direct disagreements with Nadia (regarding the unsent concession feeling like a stall) and Oren (regarding cutting "It is the best sentence..."). 
He also directly answers Nadia's new question by confirming that the blind test dragged and made him bored. Finally, he agrees with Priya about the "four minutes" repetition ruining the punchline and with Oren about the Em/Sid detours slowing down the pacing.

> 
> Nadia, my last post must have missed you. I still strongly disagree with you adding the unsent concession ('Fine. It is yours.'). It felt like a stall. > 
> Oren, I still disagree with you about cutting 'It is the best sentence in the book.' That paragraph is brilliant. Prue dropping her neutrality made me really care about the dispute. But I do agree with you on cutting the Em detour and the Sid Karr text, as well as the 'I want to be honest' aside. Mark asking around for opinions and Prue announcing the temptation just slowed down the pacing.
> 
> Cut the padding and the chapter is perfect.

Let me know if there's anything else you'd like me to do!
